translations.web: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.
translations.bsb: Now if a man loses his hair and is bald, he is still clean.
translations.kjv: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
translations.asv: And if a man's hair be fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
